balls.text: that's out of here. Kallis has finished with a poor over, and that was the poorest of the lot. Length ball on Morkel's stumps as he was opening up the off side by backing away. He saw it in the slot and just butchered it over long on. Mighty blow, and that's a nice late flourish for CSK.

you can't hit straighter than that without hitting the stumps. Yorker misses by an inch or so, as Morkel moves away to the leg side and then scythes a drive just past the stumps and it shoots across the turf for a four.
super yorker, ends up on middle and Styris quietly pats into the covers for a single
offcutter gone wrong, the angle and the turn takes it down the leg side and Styris merrily swipes his first ball in a yellow jersey over to backward square leg.

I've never seen someone appeal so hard for a bowled dismissal. That's a very useful yorker from Kallis, it was angling into the toes as Anirudha looked to whip to the leg side, but could not get the bat down in time. Hits the pad and then disturbs the furniture. Would have been lbw in any case.
Kallis sends down a full toss outside off and Morkel looks to thump it over the covers, but can't get the gap.
full toss outside off, Morkel sets up a solid base and has a wholesome swing at it, but hits it straight to long on. Just a single.
Morkel mistimes another pull as Balaji lands short of a length. Squirts off the inner half towards midwicket
another bouncer, Anirudha is hustled into the pull and top-edges it down the ground. Chennai are losing steam against these smart slow bouncers.
short ball, Anirudha is in position quickly and gets the pull shot away with pleasing timing to deep square leg where there is protection

angled across, Morkel looks to carve but gets an under edge to Bisla on the bounce, diving away to his left. They run a mad single and Bisla misses the under-arm flick. Would have been out by half a pitch
the slow bouncers are working well tonight. Balaji sends one slow outside off and Morkel looks to pull. But it is too slow, and he misses to connect.
looks to pull and misses as Kallis keeps it cannily straight and just short of a length outside off.
full and aimed at the pads as Morkel gets outside leg stump and looks to flick. Gets it away to the off side for a single
full toss, low on middle and leg, he looks to skip inside the line and pull but only gets a single
slow offcutter from Kallis, lands on a length and goes away from Morkel who steers to third man

Kallis has removed Dhoni. It is the slow bouncer. Sri Lanka, if they are watching, will be wondering why they did not try it the other night. Kallis rolls his fingers over it and the offcutter comes on much after Dhoni sets up a big backswing and looks for the whacked pull. He gets a feeble top edge and it loops up for an easy take to Bisla.
full toss, very high and on the stumps, Dhoni pulls it down the ground for a couple. Good running from Anirudha.
short ball on off stump, Dhoni skips inside the line and slap-pulls to square leg
slower ball at 98.1 kph. Dhoni grew older waiting for it and pulled away to deep square leg for a couple.
Anirudha gets a single down the ground, forcing a length ball past the bowler.
another slower ball, short and cramping Dhoni for room as he tries to cut. He gets it down to third man with a steer
slow bouncer on middle stump, Anirudha waits and whacks the pull without timing to deep midwicket
looks for the yorker straight away, Anirudha tries to crash it down the ground but can't get under it. Played to point.
gets the single this time, driving down to long on. Chennai are motoring away here. Unfortunately, KKR can't wait for the batting Powerplay to jinx them.
and the reverse sweep now. He times it pretty well, but finds the man at short third man

that's like the kind of ball a friendly dad would bowl to his five-year old son who is holding a bat for the first time. Short and excruciatingly slow outside off, Anirudha waits on the crease and pummels it over square leg.
shorter, Dhoni works it to the leg side for a single.
flatter and wisely so, Dhoni can't get it away.

oh boy, Dhoni has smashed the leather off that one. Over-pitched on middle, it might have actually been too full for the usual lofted drive. But Dhoni has the ability to make room and create that helicopter swish of the bat which means unless you york him, he will get under the ball. He sure got under that one.
full again, and wide of off stump, Dhoni drives through the covers for a single

full toss on leg stump, not a good idea when you're bowling to Dhoni. He gets it at knee height and bunts it hard down the ground in customary style. Played a few of these the other night at the Wankhede where there was some cricket match being played.
Anirudha stays back to a short ball and pulls for a single.
Dhoni muscles a length ball with considerable timing down the track for a single
Anirudha has a fifty. Fired in full on middle and he can't get it away cleanly, played into the toes to the off side and gets the single.
drops short on the stumps, Dhoni gets it away to midwicket with a forehand slap
Dhoni keeps strike with another single, square driving with the spin
faster and fuller on middle, Anirudha gets the shovel sweep away for a single to deep square leg

this has been a really queer innings from Anirudha. He's hardly looked at ease, yet played some cracking shots. At times, he's looked completely out of touch, like this. Short ball well outside off and turning well away. Surely a wide if he had left it, but he reached out ungainly and played it tamely to cover
slows it up, drops the length as Anirudha skips out and ends up foxing him in the flight again. Anirudha plays all over it and gets it to the leg side somehow.
holds it back on leg stump, Anirudha doesn't get fully to the pitch as he plays it back down down the track
tossed up by Ladda outside off, Dhoni drives in customary ugly style past cover for one
full toss on middle, but Dhoni's timing is yet to hit top gear as he mishits a slap to the leg side. Single taken.
Anirudha jumps out, Abdulla sees him and keeps it short of a length. Only a single down the ground.
back of a length, Dhoni pushes it into cover for another single
another full ball on middle and leg, Anirudha drives wide of mid on for a single
flighted outside off, Anirudha takes it on the full and square drives straight to point. Opportunity wasted.
angled into middle, Dhoni reaches out and on-drives for a single
another slow delivery on middle and leg, Dhoni pushes wide of midwicket for a single.
very full outside off, Anirudha drives with more fluency than before into the covers.
finally Bhatia loses his line and pushes one down the leg side, Anirudha is relieved as he helps it along to fine leg
Bhatia has Anirudha completely handcuffed with his slower balls. Another one with no pace at all, on middle and Anirudha looks to muscle it to the leg side but can't time it at all.
Anirudha backs away to the leg side and the full delivery on middle stump is on the slot for the cover drive. He finds cover though.
back of a length on off stump, no feet from Dhoni he just waits and forces it into the covers.
Dhoni reaches out to the flight of a full ball and turns it to the leg side for one more.
Anirudha gets inside the line and works another single backward of square leg
short ball, turning into the pads, worked with the turn to square leg

stop the press, Kolkata have held a catch. They can't believe it. The crowd can't believe it. Raina is gone. Tossed up wide outside off, Raina looks to slog-shovel it across over midwicket and holes out to Manoj Tiwary in the deep.
Morgan's dropped one now. Kolkata can't catch a cold at the moment, says Robin Jackman. Anirudha jumps out and looks to loft over midwicket, and gets it out straight to Morgan who shells it.
length ball outside off, Raina cuts it away past point.
ends with a slow offcutter, Raina gets forward and eases it through mid off for a single
another slow legcutter, Anirudha waits, waits, waits some more, and it is IPL 2012  by the time the ball comes. Cracked to the sweeper for one
this is really smart stuff from Bhatia, another legcutter outside off, nipping into Raina who can't time the forcing drive too well. Single to mid on.
over-pitched on leg stump, quietly played down to long on for a single.
over-pitched on midwicket, Raina whips viciously through midwicket for one more
full on middle stump and angling in, Anirudha whips to midwicket for a single.
nice comeback, Balaji shortens the length and gets Raina fishing outside off

shot of the day. Raina gets a length ball on middle and thumps it on the up, inside out and almost all the way over the extra cover boundary. The wrists uncorked superbly and the follow through was regal.
back of a length on the hips, Raina whips through square leg for a single.
slow bouncer, Anirudha doesn't like this lack of pace one bit. He goes really hard at the pull and cranks it away backward of square leg, but can't beat the fielder in the deep.
back of a length outside off, Raina stays on the crease and dabs to third man
Balaji sends down another slow bouncer, Anirudha can't read it and misses the cut, and Bisla can't collect it cleanly as it bounces in front of him
another slower ball, ends a good over from Bhatia. Anirudha was days early into the shot as he chipped it uppishly over mid on for a single
another leg cutter outside off, Raina reaches out and quietly drives to long off for a single
over-pitched and angling in, Anirudha whips it off the toes for a single
short of a length and angling across, Raina punches it past mid off for a single
slow legcutter on off and middle, cannily landed short of a length and Anirudha hangs back and slaps it to the leg side for a single
full and straight, on the pads and worked to square leg for a single

start the counter. The first six of the IPL. And guess what, it is not being hailed as a "DLF maximum". Lalit Modi, you are being missed! Tossed up leggie on off stump, Anirudha hops out, gets to the pitch and tees off straight over long off. That landed in the Marina beach, by the looks of it.
over-pitched on leg stump, Raina drives fluidly past mid on for a single
faster on middle and off, played with a straight ball to the leg side.
top shot from Raina. Leans out, bends the knee, gets to the pitch, gets under the ball and scoops it inside out over the covers. Top timing.
there is turn on this wicket. Back of a length outside off, spin and bounce away from Anirudha who can't control the cut and nearly finds point, diving away to his left.
lands it on leg stump from wide of the crease, and it is worked to the leg side
Raina looks to get inside the line and flick, but misses. It goes over leg stump.
keeps it on a length, Anirudha stays on the crease and dabs it to third man for a single
Chennai get a move on. Kallis hurls in that heavy-ball bouncer of his, Anirudha is clearly beaten for pace as he goes for a pull. He gets a big top edge over the keeper's head for four more.
whack. He's got good hold of this short one, and thumps it away past point with disdain. Kallis kept it marginally outside off, Anirudha stayed on leg stump and thrashed it past a diving point.
no feet at all from Anirudha as he stands at attention to a back of length ball and looks to carve in ungainly style. No timing, no surprise.

lashes away for four. Back of a length on off stump, Anirudha skips out of the crease and looks to drive, but he is not to the pitch of the ball. He throws his bat at it in anger and gets it away to fine leg in a hurry.
back of a length on middle and off, Anirudha quietly plays to the leg side.

Yusuf is having a horror start to the IPL. He's just dropped his second catch of the evening. He had three gos at this one. The first was a sitter, the second was a dolly and the third was tougher, but he held on to none. Slow bouncer, comes on after ages at Raina who looks to pull and top edges it wide of mid on. Yusuf runs back and to his left, puts his hands up and fluffs it on the run. He then fluffs the rebound. And then, as he is falling, he drops it again.
this was closer to being a wide, Raina stayed on leg stump and leant out. But he let it go as it was well outside off.
aha, Raina backed away too far as he jumped out and Balaji smartly kept it well outside off. No wide, though Raina could not reach it.

Balaji's surprise slow bouncer. It's so slow and directionless that even Raina, who doesn't play the short ball well, can get it away. It comes along at a dawdle towards the hips, and Raina rolls the wrists as he pulls it fine
angles across from over the wicket, Raina stays in the crease and steers into the off side

dropped by Yusuf on his follow through. Would have been a soft dismissal, everything happened in slow-mo there. Tossed up on off, Anirudha leans out and works it with the spin right back at Yusuf, who had to jump up and catch it over head. He got his hands to it and missed.
Raina punches off the pads through the leg side and turns the strike over
Pathan slides this well down the leg side, and they get an extra run.
juicy offspinner with a white new ball, and the field in. Money for nothing if you are a batsman. Tossed up gently on off, Anirudha slams it through the line over mid off. One bounce and over.
we don't have no UDRS here. Huge lbw appeal is turned down. Anirudha looks to shuffle across and slog sweep a full ball. Hitting in line, but possibly slipping down.
flat delivery on middle, Anirudha punches back to the bowler.
tossed up on middle, Raina leans forward and drives with the spin past mid off

over-pitched well and wide of off stump, Anirudha leans into a flamboyant cover drive. Sid Talya is reminded of Anirudha's dad playing a similar shot in the 1983 World Cup final. That came off Andy Roberts though. Slighly better bowler than Abdulla ..
length ball on the stumps, Raina hangs back in the crease and punched into the leg side for a single.
speared in on the toes, Anirudha digs it out to mid on for a tight single
he jumps out of the crease this time, Abdulla again shortens the length and Anirudha can't time the drive into the covers
once again, the batsman backs away to the leg side and ends up too far from the ball as Abdulla gets a shortish ball to turn away nicely. Anirudha cuts uppishly and straight to point
over-pitched on the pads and worked to the leg side for a single.
turning into the pads, Anirudha works it to square leg.
speared in on the pads, drilled past wide mid on for a single

a Twenty20 shot that. Yusuf keeps it short of driving and on middle. Raina jumps out and to the leg side, and ends up going too far from the ball as it breaks away. He reaches out and lofts it just over the infield and through to cover for four.
more air, and wider outside off, Raina pushes out without entirely getting to the pitch and works it to the off side
on leg stump, not much turn and tucked away off the back foot to square leg
short of a length on middle and turning in, Anirudha tucks it to square leg for one

four and out. Abdulla has sent Vijay back with some nifty left-arm spin and  we have the first wicket of the IPL. He again jumped out of the crease, Abdulla saw him and held it back on middle and got it to grip. Vijay wasn't to the pitch and still went through with an ill-advised on-drive. Straight to mid on.
Vijay's away. He had a stupendous IPL last year, how will he go this time? Jumps out to a tossed up ball on middle and clips it past mid on for a single
short of a length, Vijay pushes into the covers and thinks of a single, but Tiwary does well to cut it off
back of a length outside off and a hint of turn, Vijay adjusts and opens the face to defend to point
the first run of IPL 2011. Flighted on middle and turning away, Anirudha drives with the spin to mid off
length ball from round the wicket, Anirudha leans out to defend to the leg side

Chennai have won, somehow. I am not sure how they managed it. "He manages to find heroes everwhere," says Harsha Bhogle on air. Last year it was Bollinger. This time out of no where, after a horrible first spell, Southee turns up and bowls an unbelievable last over. Three yorkers off the last three balls! You can't ask for more. Full on middle and leg, Bhatia looks to get something, anything under it and work it to the leg side, but it hits the pads and goes nowhere. Southee appeals, but he won't mind that it wasn't given. Chepauk is abuzz. Chennai have won.
they need four off the last ball. Southee's yorker mode is turned on. He gets this one to curve away towards middle and off, Abdulla does well to outside edge it to point. Single taken.

no runs taken! 5 from 2! Southee sends in a wicked yorker a foot outside off, Abdulla tries to create room and go over the off side, but can't get bat on it. They think of a bye, Dhoni doesn't allow it.
short ball, he keeps his cool and slaps a pull over the midwicket for a couple more. Smart shot, he knew where the fielders were. 5 from 3.

this still ain't over. They need seven. Shukla plays a shot that nearly gets them four of those. He backs away to a length ball outside off and looks for an upper cut, but it wasn't short or fast enough to be sent all the way. Worse, there was third man waiting, a couple of metres inside the circle. Curtains for Shukla.

two runs taken in the most innovative manner ever. Shukla charges away to the off side, looking for a scoop and Southee keeps it full and follows the batsman who ends up squirting it off the inner half to Jakati at backward square leg. They run like headless chickens, but fast as gazelles, and Jakati's throw isn't the fastest. Two more.

ah well, this game is not done turning. Dhoni gets another stumping. Randiv holds his nerve for the last couple of balls and gets Tiwary with an armer that broke past the outside edge after enticing him out of the crease. Tiwary looked to close the face as he drove, it bounced extra but Dhoni ad no problems collecting and breaking the stumps.
short ball well outside off, came off very slowly and Tiwary could not get bat on it as he tried a dab. Brave ball to bowl at this stage, but he's managed to get a dot ball.

Tiwary has turned it around. Two blows is all it took. Randiv's melted under the pressure. Should Raina have bowled this over? This one was a length ball, landed on off and sat up beautifully for Tiwary to cart deep over square leg. Bosh. 9 from 8.
super shot! Tiwary's managed to get muscle under a very full offie, that wasn't a length ball but he did really well to get under it and launch it just over long on.
length ball, coming in from off stump and cut away into the covers for one.

huge moment. Shukla has gone for a daring reverse sweep and gets it away. Smart shot, given that Randiv's been dealing in doosras, he gets enough meat on it as it turns away and that's four more to third man.
length ball, Shukla has a swing and gets it over the covers, but Randiv charges in from the deep to keep them to a single. Close finish coming up folks!

they needed a boundary, and they've got one in fortuitous circumstances. Tight delivery, following the batsman as he backs away and landing on leg stump, Shukla has a swipe at it and gets an inside edge past fine leg,.
slow bouncer from Southee, Tiwary can't time the pull and gets it out to Raina running in from long on.
Length ball from Southee outside off, cracked powerfully into the covers. Badri does well to jump across from cover, but then doesn't stop the ball cleanly, so they get a single.
swing and a miss. No yorker from Southee, the short balls are doing the job. Shukla looks to close his eyes and swing hard, and plays some sort of a pull-cut. No contact made.
pressure! Panic! Short of a length and angling in from outside off, defended to the off side and they think of a single. No chance they will risk another run out here.
Raina ends a top-class over under pressure, with a full length ball that Shukla can't get under as he looks to pull. Single to short fine leg.

Oh boy, what has Gambhir done here?! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Gambhir gets outside the line and chips it over the covers.Morkel in the deep fumbles, but recovers quickly and sends an uncomfortable throw to Dhoni, who doesn't collect cleanly. It hits his pad and dribbles away towards short third man, but Styris was backing up like a man possessed. Gambhir thought there was a second, but was caught well short by the under-arm throw. What's with Gambhir and running? This game is turning.
width outside off, Gambhir plays a half-hearted cut to point.

Raina's done it again. He just needs to wear a yellow jersey and roll his arm over, and he promptly gets a wicket. Top-class bowling, he sees Morgan advancing, holds the length back, increase the pace and gets it to dip, grip and go away. Morgan resembles  a man searching for change in a bus as he's stranded midpitch. Dhoni collects and breaks the stumps.
full and wide outside off and lots of spin as Morgan looks to cut and misses.
Tiwary skips out, Raina sees him and drops it short and turning down the leg side. Quietly nudged to the leg side for a single.

Morgan at his best. He can make a complete mockery of lines and lengths with his unconventional shots. Ashwin knows he's up to some mischief and waits a second to see him before sending it down full on middle and off. Morgan moves the front foot forward swiftly and tonks him inside out with a vicious working over of the wrists. The ball nearly lands over the cover boundary, and he barely  broke into a sweat to make that happen.
over-pitched on the toes, Morgan works it off the angle through midwicket and they run well for a couple.
the carom ball this time, Morgan did not pick this one either, but defended from the crease.
huge turn from Ashwin, angles in from wide of the crease round the wicket and it then zoots away past a confused Morgan.

as contrived a wicket as they come. It is an attempted carom ball, but Ashwin overcooks it and sends down a full toss on middle and leg. Kallis tries mto be cute, looks to paddle sweep that and plays it straight to Badri at short fine leg. That's how you give catching practice for short fine leg fielders.
offie on middle from Ashwin, and turning in, easily tucked through square leg for a single.

aha, nearly gets him with a well-disguised slower ball. Tiwary was early into the shot and ended up scooping the off cutter outside off, half-heartedly. Raina at cover hustles to his left and dives but can't get to it.
Morkel's not turned up today with the ball. He lands this a mile outside off and it called a wide.
Kallis hurries out of the crease pre-meditatedly, Morkel keeps it short of a length outside off and it is easily dabbed past point for one
follows that up with a single, KKR are doing this easy for the moment.
poor ball, on a length with mid off inside the circle and Tiwary slams it with a cross batted swat, straight and away to the boundary in a jiffy
Kallis once again tries to steer Morkel with the pace through third man, but this time it is cut off in the deep.
starts off with a slow bouncer, Tiwary did not pick it at all and ended up fending it away uppishly to deep backward square leg
Tiwary scoots down the track yet again, but Jakati gets extra grip and turn, forcing him to feel for it outside off. Played away backward of point.
Kallis backs away to the leg side, and steers a length ball into the covers for a single.
dropped short wide outside off, Tiwary cuts it away past point
Kallis forces one past the diving Jakati and they get a single to mid on
Tiwary tees off, and Southee does well at long off. Tiwary jumps out to the pitch and launches it through mid on, Southee ran to his right and fielded it on the tumble to keep them down to a single.
Kallis has 50 off 37. Tossed up outside off and turning away, he punches the cover drive away, This man is unstoppable.
lovely bowling, Randiv bowls another drifter outside off, Manoj stays back and steers towards point for a single.

Dhoni's sent Yusuf back! Top class stuff from Captain Fantastic. Kallis was looking for the 50th run, just leant out to the off stump and looked to nudge to the leg side. The ball did not go too far and Dhoni scurried after it, but Yusuf was not quick enough. Dhoni collected, swivelled around and slung shot the stumps down with Yusuf gasping well short of the crease. Big moment, but KKR have a lot of batting to follow.
short of a length, Yusuf just hangs back this time and nudges to the square leg for a single.

huge appeal for a stumping and they go upstairs. Once again, Yusuf goes for an almighty heave across the line as Randiv slips a straighter ball outside off. It turns past the shot and Dhoni collects. Yusuf's dragged his back foot out, but then drags it back in. Looks like he got in just before Dhoni broke the stumps. Rightly given not out.
doosra from Randiv, he gets this to break away as Yusuf has a wild wild hoick at it. Not full enough, and he did not pick it at all.
another arm ball, Kallis again plays inside the line but gets an outside sdge away to the off side.
Kallis gets the third single of the over, working Ashwin in front of square .
Kallis looks to drive past cover, but can't get the gap this time.
finally gets the single, working calmly with the spin to the leg side.
offie on middle and turning in, Yusuf works it with the spin to square leg
smart ball, short of a length on off stump, played into the covers.
tight single, Kallis is beaten by the big in spin and gets an inside edge to Badri at square leg. He ran in and failed to pick up, else Yusuf could have been in trouble.
fuller on middle to end the over, Kallis reaches out to drive past mid off for a single
Kallis is doing this easy here. Jakati's lengths have been scrambled by that Yusuf hit, he drops another well short outside off and Kallis thumps it well in front of square for four.
fuller on Kallis' pads as he looks to flick and finds square leg.
this time he gets the single, steering past point for one
drops short outside off, Yusuf tries to cut but gets point.
bosh, that's trademark Yusuf. Over-pitching ain't a good idea. Jakati lands this in Yusuf's half, and Yusuf sends it to the other half of India. Reaches out, gets under it and monsters it straight.
oh beauty. Kallis is toying with his South African friend here. Length ball outside off, Kallis gets half across and opens the face with a calm flick of the wrists. Away to third man for four.
top shot from Kallis, he's manufactured a boundary with smart footwork. He jumps out and to the leg side, Morkel keeps it straight but there is enough room for him to carve over the covers.
another single, Yusuf's not played a big shot yet.
slower ball outside off, Kallis waits and dabs the offcutter backward of point.
another one back of a length outside off, not giving Yusuf the length to blast straight. Again steered to third man.
short of a length outside off, Kallis hangs back and steers to deep backward point for a single.
back of a length from round the wicket, Yusuf gets half forward and quietly defends. Now it is the Time Out.

Dhoni effects the stumping this time. Jakati has ended Bisla's adventurism at the top. Once again Bisla wanders out of the crease in search of an inside out drive, but he wasn't to the pitch and then it turned big on him. He missed and Dhoni did the rest.
full on middle and leg, swept straight to backward square leg
superb fielding from Badri at long off. Bisla runs out and looks to tee off straight and makes good contact, Badri runs to his right, slides and saves a couple.
short ball, Kallis could have whacked that out of the ground but ended up playing tamely into the covers for one
just past cover. Jakati lures Bisla out of the crease and gets him to drive uppishly inside out, Raina dives but can't get to it.
Bisla drives a full ball to long on for one more
short of a length and turning in, Kallis waits and cuts past point for one more.
full toss on the pads, can't get it away, Bisla bunts to long on for one.
length ball on middle and turning in, Bisla drives straight to mid on
Kallis works a single down the ground, fuller from Randiv and easier drive for Kallis
arm ball, lands outside off and straightens past Kallis who did not pick it as he pushed inside the line.
fullish ball on off and middle to finish the over, Kallis drives to mid off for a single.
sharp away spin, Kallis leans out and defends with the spin
top edge, but lands safe. Speared in on leg stump, Bisla looks to sweep and  gets it in the air to deep backward square leg
sharp spin again from wide of off stump, Kallis drives with the spin through cover point for a single.
fuller, Bisla gets to the spin and plays into the covers
grip and turn from outside off, Bisla jumps out and then adjusts for the spin and defends
this time he gets the single, pushing a full ball to square leg for a single.
tossed up on leg stump, Bisla works it straight to midwicket
full length on middle and off, Kallis nudges with the spin through midwicket for one
Randiv sends this turning well down the leg side and this time Dhoni does well to collect.
going down the leg side, worked along off the back foot for a single.
missed stumping, what happened there? Was that an arm ball? Bisla did not pick it, charging out and past it. Dhoni did not pouch it cleanly, seemed to bounce more than he expected.
short and wide outside off, very smart batting from Bisla who backs away and helps it along to the right of point for four.
Bisla skips out again, Ashwin follows him on leg stump and gets chipped airily through the leg side for one more
Kallis gets the front foot across and works him with the spin to short fine leg for a single.
over-pitched on middle and leg, Kallis plays it back down the track
hmm, risky but he gets it away, lap sweeping from outside off, square of leg slip for a couple.
carom ball, breaks away from outside off, Kallis watches closely and defends
length ball turns in from outside off, Bisla nudges with the spin backward of square for one
the field is back on the off side, and there's another easy single to be had. Bisla steers through point for a single.
offcutter, comes in from outside off and Kallis quietly plays it into the covers for a single
another one goes away. Southee's losing the plot and KKR's chase is off to a very good start. This one is too full and slants well down the leg side, kallis clips it along for four more.
take that, Southee. Bouncer, doesn't go off at all and ends up in the slot for Kallis to pummel emphatically over midwicket for four. Pulled with power.

the format might change, but Kallis' methods won't. Lovely shot, threading the gap between point and cover with precision. Southee gives him a sliver of width outside off and Kallis square drives with authority .
back of a length ball coming into Kallis who check drives to midwicket. Randiv runs and dives, cuts it off nicely
bad ball to finish off. Ashwin slowed up on his delivery stride to see what Bisla was up to and then delivered it slow and full outside leg. Easily swing away behind square leg
another carom ball, too straight this time and Bisla can't get the nudge away
here comes the carom ball, lands on middle and nips away from Bisla who can't get it away
aha big appeal for lbw as he turns one in from outside off and Kallis looked to flick. Did he get the bat on it? Hit in front of middle and given as runs. Replays not conclusive.
big turn. Too much for his own good. Landed outside off, spun a mile and Dhoni could not get his hands to it. Five wides down the leg side
fuller on middle and leg, worked to the leg side cautiously for a single
Bisla advances, Ashwin drops it back of a length and he defends to the leg side
short and a touch wide to end the over, Bisla cuts away backward of point for a single.
moves the ball to a line outside off and gets it to nudge in off the seam, Bisla covers the line and defends to the off side
gets inside the line and looks to whip, and this time he gets a single.
bouncer at 135 kph, good enough to hustle Kallis into a hurried pull shot. He still timed it well, but found the man at square leg
Kallis shuffles inside the line and works to square leg for a single.
angles in from a length towards the pads, worked easily to square leg
back of a length outside off, Kallis stays in the crease and punches into the covers for a single.

poor ball, Morkel angles too far down the leg side and Kallis' natural shuffle across gets him well inside the line. He easily glances it down to fine leg for a four. These two South Africans have produced 14 runs off the last 3 head-to-head balls.
angling into the pads this time, clipped square for a single. Over to Kallis.
slam bang. Bisla scurries out of the crease and to the leg side, Morkel tries to angle it into the pads but ends up landing it in the slot and Bisla cracks it on the move through the covers
fuller this time, and played cautiously down the track
length ball on off stump, Bisla gets half forward and drives fluently into the covers.
